## What is Event Analytics Hub?

Event Analytics Hub combines two things: written analysis and interactive
exploration. Blog posts explain the concepts and show the key findings.
Dashboards let you dig into the data yourself.

## How the blog and dashboards connect

Every analysis on this blog links to an interactive dashboard where you can
explore the data with your own filters. For example, here's a simple summary
of event counts by quarter:

```{r}
#| label: quarterly-summary
#| echo: true

library(ggplot2)

events <- data.frame(
  period = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"),
  count = c(120, 185, 210, 175)
)

ggplot(events, aes(x = period, y = count, fill = period)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Event count by quarter", x = "Period", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Want to filter this data by event type, source, or date range?

[Explore this data in the dashboard →](http://localhost:3838/?period=Q3){.explore-cta}
